item.title: Apple teases ‘Surprise and Shine’ event; iPhone 18 Pro, foldable iPhone may debut
item.summary: Apple's 2026 major event is set for September 9, where excitement brews over the launch of the iPhone 18 Pro and Pro Max. Notably, a unique foldable iPhone is on the horizon, likely to steal the spotlight. Fans can also expect fresh color choices and innovative mechanical aperture technology in the Pro series. The standard model will arrive next year, with more advancements lined up for 2027.
